# Test cases CI skips: they need a real GPU, real displays, a hardware video encoder, real-time scheduling or engine
# processes started under the supervisor, which GitHub's macOS runners do not provide. They run in the full local
# suite (`ctest`) and on the show machine.
*--composition starts the engine on the file*
*a disconnected display parks its output*
*a full disk stops the recording cleanly*
*a hung or crashed UI leaves rendering*
*a layer whose decoder gets stuck in a read*
*a live recording rolls over without a dropped frame*
*a node follows the main engine's beat clock*
*a projector power-cycled five times*
*a restart keeps the show file the saved state belongs to*
*a show held at start-up misses no frames*
*a slowed output does not affect the other outputs*
*after a restart*screens find their displays by identity*
*desk: killing the desk process leaves the engine's frames running*
*displays: a projector back under a new id*
*displays: macOS mirroring displays*
*djlink: the simulator's scenario drives the beat clock*
*for a minute of selections*
*on a slow decoder*
*once locked*every output shows each rendered frame*
*recording never stalls rendering*
*return audio: a Director that stops reading*
*the frame guard still halves a previewed layer*
*the machine status names each output's state*
*the selected clip's preview never costs the show*
*under GPU overload the render rate degrades evenly*
*watching the return video*
*with --realtime-frames*
*Autopilot resumes on the clip it had stepped to*
*a clip that crashed the engine while opening*
*a hung engine is killed after 2 s without a frame*
*a killed engine restarts and resumes the same clip*
*a restart asked for over the protocol comes back with the same show*
*crashes on another thread while a clip opens*
*ctl's venue lines*
*parity: a trigger on an Autopiloted layer shows manual*
*safe mode asked for over the protocol is entered*
*the Machines tab watches the machine only while it is visible*
*the Show lock refuses restart and safe mode*
*the audio input picked at runtime is open again*
*the recording settings set at runtime are kept*
*GPU time per built-in ISF shader at 1080p*
*GPU time per generator at 1080p*
*displays per machine: the gig show's screen stays on the Dell*
*djlink: the receiver hears a loopback feed*
*two live engines over loopback agree on the beat*
*without counter sampling the preview timer falls back*
*map arrangement: a hidden screen's output keeps presenting*
*an effect edit on the selected clip recompiles its preview off the render thread*
*clip previews turn on and off live*
